title: Recover a failed vendor payment
instruction: The payment against invoice VINV-108 failed because Tri-State Fasteners' bank details were out of date, and the invoice is now overdue. Their finance contact has confirmed new details. Record the corrected contact email as ar@tristatefasteners.example, then put through a fresh payment for the full outstanding amount and complete it so the invoice is settled. Marcus Lindqvist (USR-006) raises payments and Sofia Duarte (USR-007) approves them.
